verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Osborne Clarke advises high-growth companies 'from incorporation through to exit' and publishes UK and DE cap table templates and an investor-readiness tool. Nothing in the pack shows published guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction of incorporation, such as Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd. Advisory incorporation services alone do not meet a story about published entity-selection guidance.
